name: Australian AI Governance Framework
description: Australian AI governance framework, built around the legislation a specific organisation's use of AI actually triggers. Profiles an organisation by industry, size, turnover, state, AI use cases and data types, then identifies the Commonwealth and state instruments that apply to that profile — the Privacy Act 1988 and its Notifiable Data Breaches scheme, the automated decision-making disclosure required in privacy policies from 10 December 2026 under APP 1.7, and sector-specific regimes such as the Heavy Vehicle National Law, the Fair Work Act 2009 or the Security of Critical Infrastructure Act 2018. Structured around the six essential practices (AI6) in the National AI Centre's Guidance for AI Adoption, October 2025. The free preview covers the first two practices; the complete six-practice framework is a one-time $88 AUD including GST purchase at aiframework.com.au. Informational only — presents a framework, not advice.
author: Kentron

tools.name: start_australian_ai_governance_framework
tools.description: Identifies the Australian legislation that applies to a specific organisation's use of AI, and builds a governance framework around it. Covers the Privacy Act 1988 including the automated decision-making disclosure required in privacy policies from 10 December 2026 under APP 1.7, plus the sector-specific Commonwealth and state instruments triggered by that organisation's industry, size, turnover, AI use cases and data types. Returns a session ID and the profiling questionnaire. Informational only — presents a framework, not advice.

tools.name: submit_ai_governance_profile
tools.description: Submits the organisation profile and contact details for an Australian AI governance framework. The profile determines which legislation the framework identifies, so the answers should reflect the organisation's actual circumstances — turnover in particular, since the Privacy Act's small business threshold sits at $3 million and several categories are caught regardless of turnover. Returns a status of profile_saved; call get_ai_governance_framework next.

answers.description: Keys are question ids returned by start_australian_ai_governance_framework; values are the selected option (string) or options (array)

tools.name: get_ai_governance_framework
tools.description: Returns the framework. The free preview covers the first two of the six AI6 practices in the National AI Centre's Guidance for AI Adoption — Accountability and Impact Assessment — together with the legislative mapping for the profile supplied. The result includes a view_url for reading the document in a browser and a purchase_url that opens the website checkout with the profile already loaded. The complete six-practice framework is a one-time $88 AUD including GST purchase at aiframework.com.au; there is no payment through this endpoint. Both links expire two hours after the profile was created. Informational only — presents a framework, not advice or compliance guidance.
